verdict.rationale: The skills are published as plain SKILL.md files in a public MIT repo, so their raw instructions can be read before installing (docs-5, docs-6, docs-9, docs-42). The npx installer lets you pick skills and writes them into your repo as ordinary, editable files you own and can read afterward, with no silent updates (docs-24, docs-47, docs-4); community members confirm learning from reading the skills (comm-1). However, the plugin install route is a read-only bundle that updates itself by default, which weakens after-the-fact review (gh-9, gh-10, docs-41). Missing for 10: a documented pre-install command to list or preview a skill's full file contents, explicit coverage of bundled scripts beyond SKILL.md instructions, and a review step before auto-updates on the plugin route.
